bug_info.bug_desc: In the KMAC main FSM state KmacMsgFeed, the transition logic only checks sha3_absorbed. If the SHA3 core asserts sha3_absorbed and sha3_done in the same cycle, the FSM moves to KmacDigest and misses the done pulse. KmacDigest then waits for sha3_done, which has already passed, so the FSM can remain stuck in KmacDigest with entropy_in_progress held high and never return to KmacIdle. This can happen for application-interface operations where the kmac_app FSM issues CmdDone immediately when it sees absorbed, causing both signals to be active together.
bug_info.fix_hint: In the KmacMsgFeed state, handle the simultaneous absorbed and done case explicitly: when sha3_absorbed && sha3_done, transition directly to KmacIdle; otherwise, only transition to KmacDigest when sha3_absorbed is asserted without sha3_done; otherwise remain in KmacMsgFeed. This prevents the lost done event and ensures the FSM returns to idle and clears entropy status for the next operation.
